scope: Follow-up Megamono source and scaffold work for Browser Sweet. No existing adopter migration, hosted CI, public npm/shared Yalc publication, Playstack source changes, browser-runtime admission or deployment qualification is implied.

items.assessment: All six documentation generator schemas describe the generator/options and required versus inferred values. Invalid input, unknown topics and unresolved references fail before record creation; valid planned documentation namespaces remain supported.
New docs/content declarations use ^4.6.5. Existing broad declarations admitting unsupported versions are review conflicts before writes; declarations are not silently rewritten.

Explicit package-level runtimeEntries plus independent accepted-decision authority attest renderer/worker roots. Only observed static/dynamic renderer-only uses can consume web projects. Worker/unclassified reachability, Node built-ins, implicit edges and other boundaries remain restricted.
Localization rule skips spec/test files and __tests__ by default and supports explicit gitignore-style ignorePatterns plus ignoreTests:false. Dev/story files are not silently excluded.

Health adds advisory per-application installed React/Chakra/Emotion evidence, deduplicating real installations and distinguishing unavailable assessment. This is Node resolution evidence rather than browser bundle or provider-context admission.

Localization diagnostics describe message catalogs/localization calls accurately and state that inline-literal checks do not prove translation completeness. No i18n dependency is installed automatically.

Health identifies undeclared static/dynamic imports between named owned workspace packages, even when root dependencies are hoisted. This advisory does not add a new structural-check error or modify warning budgets.

Explicit React flat-config APIs use the imported installed Hooks preset and preserve configuration/plugin identity. Newly generated web/site and web UI libraries receive scoped source rules; existing projects and Expo are not migrated.

extensionContract.decisionAuthority: Independent accepted repository decision lookup, including when optional docs checking is skipped.
extensionContract.completeMeaning: Source consistency under author-attested complete roots. Dynamic WXT configuration and hooks are not executed or automatically proven.
extensionContract.report: Checker JSON extensionRuntime includes project, contract, complete and applied source/target/dependencyKind evidence.
extensionContract.rendererScope: Literal HTML-backed renderer roots only. WXT content scripts and dynamically discovered entries are not automatically renderer-qualified; unclassified production roots retain worker restrictions.

notCompleted.assessment: Known non-runtime files may be omitted from extension entry inventory, but are traced if runtime-reachable. This is not a general scripts/config/tests Node-platform exemption.
Bundle attribution, safe subpath exports and side-effect policy remain open. No blanket sideEffects:false or browser-bundle completeness claim was added.

focusedCheckpoints.note: Four-file focused suite: 31 passed, then the dependency suite: 12 passed after adding one atomic adoption case; 32 distinct covered cases.
Real docs-research Nx help reports meaningful generator/options text, explicit required wording and no undefined descriptions.

earlierConsumerAttempts.resolution: Added the minimal valid empty fixture registry, retained ownership validation and reran successfully without product source changes.

findings.assessment: Previously recorded transitive tooling finding remains; this audit is not a zero-finding result. No new exception was added.

limitations: Existing adopter projects and their policies are not migrated or approved automatically.
Installed module inspection is resolve-only, does not execute inspected JavaScript, and does not use ambient NODE_PATH fallback.
Missing/malformed dependency evidence produces partial advisory coverage rather than a complete runtime assessment.
No broad platform exception, warning-budget increase or dependency audit exception was added.
Remaining first-wave issues retain their previous status unless explicitly listed in this follow-up.
